variants.reference: Original 40-segment ellipses, empty slots retained, 60Hz continuous scenes
variants.optimized60: Optimized geometry and pruning, 60Hz continuous scenes
variants.current: Production optimized geometry and pruning, 30Hz continuous scenes

method: 600 measured 60Hz ticks after 60 warmup ticks, actual installed Squisher and Common runtime; four players, 300s round. Setup; first-course idle; or stage-6 seeded automatic shots. All three variants share the captured current source and 60Hz physics; only ellipse detail, pruning and scene interval differ. Lifecycle and gesture draws remain immediate; synthetic input is injected just before each tick and coalesced by Squisher. Gameplay-state equality is asserted across all three variants. Byte comparisons model RTC duplicate suppression; cached frames are still sampled on ticks without an emission. Host-to-three-guests excludes local host. Timing includes tick, serialization, four filtered frame buffers and comparisons; excludes network overhead, media loading, browser rendering and mobile/WAN. No capacity claim.
